title: Waiting at the Bus Stop
text:
The bus stop outside our block is busy every morning. Office workers stand at the front, checking their phones. Schoolchildren gather near the pole, swinging their bags and talking too loudly.
Auntie Siva is always there before everyone else. She sits on the bench with her shopping trolley beside her, and she greets each person who arrives.
When the bus finally pulls in, something quiet happens. The students step back. The office workers wait. Auntie Siva climbs on first, one careful step at a time, and nobody hurries her at all.
